# ProtoStack

> Validate the idea before you build the product.

ProtoStack is a rapid-prototyping template for turning a product idea into a
demoable walking skeleton — auth, database, and a flat design system wired up,
so a new idea starts at the interesting part.

## Pages

- [Home](/): what ProtoStack is and how to get started.

## Notes

- Google Search does not read this file; Anthropic and OpenAI agent workflows do.
  It's cheap to keep accurate — /prototype rewrites it per idea. See docs/seo.md.
